notes.title: Patch 0.0.2 - Challenge your friends
notes.notes:
[b] Updates [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some UI bugs
[*] Setting have been added to the menu
[*] You can now play vs your friends (automatically picks the first deck for each player , working on it)
[*] Reduced the game size by 600mb
[*] Reduce the turn time from 2 min to 75 seconds
[*] Added a 45 sec timer to the hand selection menu
[/list]


[b] Know urgent bugs [/b]

[list]
[*]  Issue when a player leaves an lobby and simultasneoly another player is looking for a lobby
[/list]
